```yaml
name: Check for old group references

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-old-group:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search for old group references
        id: grep
        run: |
          echo "Searching for references to kibana/cloud-security-posture..."
          if grep -R -n -I "kibana/cloud-security-posture" .; then
            echo "found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Comment on PR if old references found
        if: steps.grep.outputs.found == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const comment = `
⚠️ **Deprecated Group Reference Detected**

The pull request contains references to the old GitHub group **kibana/cloud-security-posture**.  
Please update all references to the new group **kibana/contextual-security** in the codebase, configuration, and documentation.

Thank you!`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });
```
